gain_rejection: 880MHz RX60 QPSK clipped (~42% lanes in TX-on windows). RX40 QPSK passes. OFDM TX75/RX40 had rare near-rail peaks; TX65/RX40 eliminates sampled clipping.
window_correction: Finite Done! is end, not readiness. Current runner uses LO lock then natural finiteTX exit +0.75s online tail. Host timestamps do not measure physical RF timing.
rx2600: RX40->50 improved OFDM EVM13.5%->3.99% and FER36.6%->9.32%; RX55 FER11.35%, no further benefit. Stop gain grid; reason unresolved, not unsupported or interference diagnosis.
legacy_qpsk_sequence_scope: Old1800/2300 long sources repeat every15s; payload quality only. New2300 long uses continuous unique sequences; see communication-qpsk-legacy-waveform-review.json.
bw1_scope: 3.84Msps physical rate, same sample geometry; QPSK480ksym/s, OFDM15kHz spacing/96occupied bins. Not full BW1 passband measurement.
qpsk_timing_correction: Preamble-only parabolic timing/linear interpolation, one retained matched-filter sample. Full sample-phase, bidirectional20ppm and payload-inversion negative tests. v1 BW1 short EVM12.69%; v2 corrected short11.22%. 1375MHz unchanged gain13.26%->11.70%. Changes host demod only, not RF Auto or USB.
bandwidth_test_policy: Only USB-sustainable full raw rates are tested: activeBW0/BW1; BW2 not scheduled for insufficient sustained margin, BW3-5 excluded. Existing partial-output evidence retained.
source_acquisition_scope: New reports count complete unique finite-source frames, including start/tail/internal and host gaps, using bounded bitmaps. This is a source-file denominator, not measured actual RF transmission or precise sample loss.
